name: Joe's iOS Builds
subtitle: OpenNOW, VoidLink, ChargeLens, Husk, and KumoPlay builds

apps.name: Husk
apps.developerName: Husk contributors; local build by Joe
apps.localizedDescription: Husk 0.6.1 (build 12) fixes iPad touch input: uses the known mouse-compatible touch path by default, restoring taps and drags. The direct-touch option remains experimental. Keeps an aspect-matched iPad Android panel at a bounded ~0.3-megapixel workload. First launch cold-boots Android once to save a snapshot matching the virtual touchscreen/display hardware; existing Android files are retained. Built from Leviidev/Husk commit 65d0d122a139fa7ed53db6df84ed6737e3216d29. Requires JIT. Unsigned IPA.

apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4 (Experimental)
apps.localizedDescription: Build 210 reduces NIS allocation pressure on target changes. Retires old Metal 4 texture pools safely and avoids a duplicate NIS fallback pool while preparation finishes. Keeps Screen/1.5×/2× targets, MetalFX/NIS/FSR1, adaptive HDR and rendering/controller fixes. Full-size NIS checks at 3840×1620 and 5120×2160, Metal 4 handoff, simulator check and Release archive passed. Reported iPhone freeze requires device verification. Unsigned IPA for KravaSigner.

apps.name: VoidLink PyroWave
apps.localizedDescription: VoidLink contributors; local PyroWave build with mouse and desktop scaling changes.

apps.name: ChargeLens
apps.localizedDescription: Charging sensor app for iPhone and iPad (iOS/iPadOS 26+). Live input watts, volts and amps, separate battery watts, graphs, saved sessions and CSV export. Correct device-specific sensor labels and a wider iPad landscape layout. Reads this device’s private hardware sensors; availability depends on the device and OS. 26 tests passed on each simulator. Unsigned IPA for installer signing.

apps.name: KumoPlay
apps.developerName: Local builds by Joe; Pylux / Chiaki streaming core
apps.localizedDescription: PlayStation Remote Play and PS Plus cloud streaming for iPhone and iPad (iOS/iPadOS 17+), from the same codebase as the Mac app. 0.9.49 (build 49): use the whole app with a controller (D-pad/stick to move, ✕ select, ○ back, L1/R1 tabs, in-game menu with L3 + Options); the on-screen controller hides when a controller connects; an on-screen touchpad for controllers without one; GameSir G8 Plus vibration and back buttons; theme icons in the app switcher. Unsigned for distribution (ad-hoc only); the installer signs it. AGPL-3.0 with OpenSSL exception; source is in the release.
